findings.title: Convert cents before formatting quick estimates
findings.comment: Concrete failure at api.ts:75: `baseRateFor("domestic", 2)` returns 590 cents, which `quickEstimate` renders as `"590.00"` rather than `"5.90"`. The cent-to-dollar conversion is missing.

findings.title: Restore positive finite validation in quoteShipment
findings.comment: The base version validated `Number.isFinite(req.weightKg) && req.weightKg > 0` in `quoteShipment`; that guard is gone. Direct callers no longer receive `RangeError`, and `handleQuote` returns 200 for zero, negative, NaN, or infinite numeric inputs, contradicting the documented validation contract.

findings.title: Keep tier upper bounds inclusive
findings.comment: Both the `WeightTier` interface and README explicitly define `maxKg` as inclusive, but rates.ts:42 uses `<`. Exact 1, 5, and 20 kg values are all assigned to the next tier and overcharged.

coverage.lens: Scrutinize the dollars-to-cents migration across rates, discounts, quote assembly, and API serialization. Verify unit conversions, rounding direction, and breakdown totals.
Check pricing behavior at exact weight-tier boundaries. Also verify that removing validation from quoteShipment does not expose direct callers to invalid numeric inputs.
Verify compatibility of the expanded quote response and renamed exported pricing interfaces. Pay attention to consumers that may still expect dollar-based fields or functions.
